name: openbr-desktop
description: OpenBR Desktop Application for Linux and Windows

scripts.dev:debug: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri dev --features devtools
scripts.build:linux: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.build:linux:arm: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.build:windows: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:mac: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac:arm: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:universal: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.release:all: npm run build:linux && npm run build:windows

author: OpenBR Team
